narration:11:14010822:0.text: Indris nears the brink of corruption, his resolve hardening as he rejects the Divine Dew. As his body contorts in pain, the Sylvan Tendril swoops in and soothes his torment.
narration:11:14010822:0.source_cn: 因度厄似乎快要孽化了，但他拒绝再喝灵露了。此时，织叶飞...
